topics.title: Anchor 1: Generate and conceptualize artistic ideas

outcomes.text: Describe how sounds and short musical ideas can represent experiences, moods, images or storylines.

topics.title: Anchor 2: Organize and develop artistic ideas

outcomes.text: Assemble and organize sounds or short musical ideas into first expressions of chosen experiences, moods or storylines.
Identify and describe how sounds and short ideas develop in drafts using simple forms like one-part, cyclical or binary.

topics.title: Anchor 3: Refine and complete artistic work

outcomes.text: Use teacher-provided criteria to assess and refine the technical and expressive sides of drafts.
Share music through notation, performance or technology and show how elements of music express intent.
Describe the given context and performance medium for presenting personal works and how they affect the final piece.

topics.title: Anchor 4: Select, analyze, and interpret artistic work for presentation

outcomes.text: Identify and select passages in musical works in simple forms that express an experience, mood, image or storyline.
Analyze how the elements of music, including form, relate to style and mood, and explain what this means for rehearsal.
Develop interpretations from the use of elements, style and mood, explaining how choices reflect the creators' intent.

topics.title: Anchor 5: Develop and refine artistic techniques for presentation

outcomes.text: Create rehearsal plans identifying repetition and variation within the form.
Use criteria and feedback to identify how performances convey elements of music, style and mood.
Identify and use strategies to improve the technical and expressive sides of several works.

topics.title: Anchor 6: Convey meaning through the presentation of artistic work

outcomes.text: Share live or recorded performances of works and explain how elements of music convey intent.
Identify how compositions suit an audience or context and how this shapes future compositions.

topics.title: Anchor 7: Perceive and analyze artistic work

outcomes.text: Apply teacher-provided criteria to select music expressing an experience, mood or storyline, and describe it as a model for composition.
Analyze by ear the elements of music, relating them to style, mood and context, and describe the analysis as a model for growth.

topics.title: Anchor 8: Interpret intent and meaning in artistic work

outcomes.text: Develop and explain interpretations of works, citing technical and expressive aspects and style or genre to show composers' intent.

topics.title: Anchor 9: Apply criteria to evaluate artistic work

outcomes.text: Describe the effectiveness of technical and expressive aspects of music and performances using music theory fundamentals.
Describe how critiquing others' work and getting feedback can be used in your own creative process.

topics.title: Anchor 10: Relate artistic ideas and works to societal, cultural and historical context

outcomes.text: Show how interests, knowledge and skills relate to personal choices and intent in creating, performing and responding to music.

topics.title: Anchor 11: Synthesize and relate knowledge and personal experiences to make art

subtopics.title: Music and other arts, disciplines and daily life

outcomes.text: Show understanding of relationships between music and the other arts, other disciplines, varied contexts and daily life.

topics.title: Anchor 1: Generate and conceptualize artistic ideas

outcomes.text: Describe and show how sounds and musical ideas can represent sonic events, memories, concepts, texts or storylines.

topics.title: Anchor 2: Organize and develop artistic ideas

outcomes.text: Assemble and organize several sounds or ideas into first expressive statements of chosen events, memories, concepts or texts.
Describe and explain how ideas develop in drafts in simple or moderately complex forms like binary, rondo or ternary.

topics.title: Anchor 3: Refine and complete artistic work

outcomes.text: Use teacher-provided or personal criteria to assess and refine the technical and expressive sides of drafts.
Share music through notation, performance or technology and describe how elements and compositional techniques express intent.
Describe chosen contexts and mediums for presenting personal works and explain why they shape the final piece well.

topics.title: Anchor 4: Select, analyze, and interpret artistic work for presentation

outcomes.text: Identify and select passages or movements in works in simple or moderately complex forms that express experiences, moods, concepts or texts.
Analyze how the elements of music relate to style, function and context, and explain what this means for rehearsal.
Develop interpretations from elements, style, mood, function and context, supporting how choices reflect intent.

topics.title: Anchor 5: Develop and refine artistic techniques for presentation

outcomes.text: Create rehearsal plans identifying form, repetition and variation, and the style and context of the work.
Use criteria and feedback to identify how performances convey formal design, style and context.
Identify and use strategies to improve the technical and expressive sides of varied works.

topics.title: Anchor 6: Convey meaning through the presentation of artistic work

outcomes.text: Share performances of works and explain how elements and compositional techniques convey intent.
Explain how compositions suit both audience and context and how this shapes future compositions.

topics.title: Anchor 7: Perceive and analyze artistic work

outcomes.text: Apply teacher-provided or personal criteria to select music in simple or moderately complex forms, and defend it as a model.
Analyze by ear or score the elements and compositional techniques, relating them to style, mood and context, and explain the model for growth.

topics.title: Anchor 8: Interpret intent and meaning in artistic work

outcomes.text: Develop and support interpretations, citing elements, form, techniques, style and context to show composers' intent.

topics.title: Anchor 9: Apply criteria to evaluate artistic work

outcomes.text: Explain the effectiveness of technical and expressive aspects using music theory and compositional techniques.
Describe how critiquing others and receiving feedback have been applied in your own creative process.

topics.title: Anchor 10: Relate artistic ideas and works to societal, cultural and historical context

outcomes.text: Show how interests, knowledge and skills relate to personal choices and intent in creating, performing and responding to music.

topics.title: Anchor 11: Synthesize and relate knowledge and personal experiences to make art

topics.title: Anchor 1: Generate and conceptualize artistic ideas

outcomes.text: Describe and show several ways sounds and musical ideas can represent extended sonic experiences or abstract ideas.

topics.title: Anchor 2: Organize and develop artistic ideas

outcomes.text: Assemble and organize sounds or extended ideas into first expressive statements of extended experiences or abstract ideas.
Analyze and show how sounds and extended ideas develop in drafts in moderately complex or complex forms.

topics.title: Anchor 3: Refine and complete artistic work

outcomes.text: Research, explain and apply personal criteria to assess and refine the technical and expressive sides of drafts.
Share music through notation, performance or technology and explain how elements, techniques and processes express intent.
Describe many possible contexts and mediums for presenting personal works and compare how each could affect success.

topics.title: Anchor 4: Select, analyze, and interpret artistic work for presentation

outcomes.text: Identify and select sections, movements or whole works in moderately complex or complex forms that express experiences, concepts or texts.
Analyze how elements and compositional techniques relate to style, function and context, and support the analysis for rehearsal and performance.
Develop interpretations from elements, form, techniques, style, function and context, justifying how choices reflect intent.

topics.title: Anchor 5: Develop and refine artistic techniques for presentation

outcomes.text: Create rehearsal plans identifying form, repetition and variation, compositional techniques, style and context.
Use criteria and feedback to identify how performances use compositional techniques and convey design, style and context.
Identify, compare and use strategies to improve the technical and expressive sides of contrasting works.

topics.title: Anchor 6: Convey meaning through the presentation of artistic work

outcomes.text: Share performances of works and explain or show how the expressive intent is conveyed.
Explain how compositions suit a variety of audiences and contexts and how this shapes future compositions.

topics.title: Anchor 7: Perceive and analyze artistic work

outcomes.text: Apply researched or personal criteria to select music in moderately complex or complex forms, and justify it as a model.
Analyze by ear or score the elements and techniques, relating them to aesthetic effectiveness, style, mood and context.

topics.title: Anchor 8: Interpret intent and meaning in artistic work

outcomes.text: Develop, justify and defend interpretations, citing elements, form, techniques, style and context to show composers' intent.

topics.title: Anchor 9: Apply criteria to evaluate artistic work

outcomes.text: Evaluate the effectiveness of technical and expressive aspects using theoretical concepts and complex techniques.
Describe and evaluate how critiquing others and receiving feedback have been applied in your creative process.

topics.title: Anchor 10: Relate artistic ideas and works to societal, cultural and historical context

outcomes.text: Show how interests, knowledge and skills relate to personal choices and intent in creating, performing and responding to music.
